text:
maya: Morning — nightly eval flagged a big drop for pset_v30 after the promptset roll. EM down ~8% and hallucination rate spiked. anyone else seeing this?

eval-bot: nightly-eval alert · pset_v30 · severity=high · metrics: EM -8.1% vs baseline, hallucinations +12% · https://ci.redwood/evals/1954321000 · (details attached)

liam: yikes. was there a model/quant change, or just promptset?

maya: just promptset. no model changes in the deploy history. we tweaked a handful of instruction templates in v30.

maya: snippet of the most suspicious diff:

```
- "Answer in a sentence."
+ "Answer in a concise sentence. If unknown, reply 'I don't know'."
```

sara: hmm that seems like it should reduce hallucinations, not increase them. can you paste 2–3 failing examples from the eval?

maya: pasted 3 failing generations in the eval payload:
1) Q: "When did company X acquire project Y?" — Golden: 2018. Model: invented 2021 and elaborated why.
2) Q: "What is the capital of region Z?" — Golden: City A. Model: returns City B with fabricated population stats.
3) Q: "List the supported formats for widget API." — Golden: [json, yaml]. Model: adds csv and an endpoint that doesn't exist.

zane: that looks like confident hallucination. possible that the added "If unknown, reply 'I don't know'" is being ignored and instead triggers a more verbose defensive answer which veers into made-up facts. also check the eval harness normalization — any change there could affect EM.

liam: quick sanity check: can we run a paired eval v29 vs v30 on the same model/distribution? run with same seeds, no quant differences.

liam: run command I used locally:
```
./tools/run_eval --pset pset_v29,v30 --model rwd-1-medium --seed 42 --out /tmp/pset30_ab.json
```

maya: kicked off the job, link: https://ci.redwood/evals/job/1954321015 · started 1954321020

eval-bot: job finished · results: v29 EM=78.4% · v30 EM=70.2% · hallucination_rate v29=4.1% v30=16.3% · full diff: https://ci.redwood/evals/1954321015/results

sara: that's a large regression and consistent with your examples. my recommendation: revert the specific template change in v30 for now, mark the pset as unstable, and open a controlled rebaseline PR only after we add negative tests.

zane: agree. also add a canary rollout plan: rebaseline only after canary on 5% of nightly, monitor hallucination metric and EM. file a follow-up to add explicit negcases that trigger abstain behavior.

maya: created PR to revert the single template line: https://git.redwood/psets/PR-498 · description: revert "If unknown, reply 'I don't know'" change for triage. added unit test notes and linked failing examples.

liam: for the rebaseline process we need 2 approvals from ML leads + a short eval summary. cc @sara @zane for approvals.

sara: approving the revert for triage. :thumbsup:

zane: approving the revert to unblock. leaving a TODO in the PR to add negative examples and an eval patch.

maya: thanks — filing follow-up issue for prompt engineering work: https://issues.redwood/ML-1345 (add negcases, update eval harness normalization).

devex-bot: rebaseline request created in the console · id=rb-1954321100 · status=pending · approvers=[sara,zane]

eval-bot: scheduled rerun with reverted promptset in ~45m (nightly queue). monitoring channel: #pset-rebases.

maya: I'll watch the rerun and post updates. thanks everyone for quick triage. :pray:
